title: Patch: the card pictures' scene kits and recipes load alongside the engine module, not in the first page load
notes: The card pictures' scene kits and recipes no longer ship in the first page load (#4222). scene.ts keeps its API and reads the four tables from an installed slot filled by loadSceneData() beside loadWasm(); EngineGate and useEngineReady wait for both, failing closed on a scene-chunk failure, and sceneRecipeOf throws before install so an early face fails a test instead of drawing the wrong picture. Nothing visible changes. Claims --visual because the change touches apps/web/src/cards/ (R2529000), a micro of no family.

player.title: Faster first load, same card pictures
fixes: The first page loads faster on a slow connection, with the same card pictures.
